fields.cost: What the money this wallet took out through withdrawals had cost it, in whole dollars, or null when it never withdrew.
fields.cut: The leader's cut the wallet paid on its withdrawals, in whole dollars, or null when it never withdrew.
fields.leader: true when this wallet leads the vault: a leader is never counted as an outside depositor, the cut on its own profit is paid to itself, and the cuts it collected from depositors are not in its figures.
fields.listed_result: The wallet's all-time result in the vault on the venue's own list, in whole dollars, payouts and money still inside included: the leader's cuts already taken are off it, the cut on profit still inside is not and is taken when that money leaves, and it is null when the venue does not list the wallet.
fields.received: What reached the wallet for that money, after the leader's cut, in whole dollars, or null when it never withdrew.
fields.result: received minus cost, which is what the wallet took home on the money it withdrew, in whole dollars, or null when it never withdrew.
fields.status: Where the wallet stands in the vault, as one of the fixed sentences explained under status_meanings.
fields.uses: Which figure stands for the wallet's result in this vault, ledger for the result key or list for the listed_result key.
fields.vault: The address of the vault this record is about.
fields.vault_state: Whether the vault was open or closed on the day of the data.
fields.why: Why that figure is the one used, as one of the fixed sentences listed under why_sentences.
fields.withdrawals: How many withdrawals the wallet made from the vault.

status_meanings.left: The wallet withdrew and the venue does not list it with money inside.
status_meanings.no longer inside: The wallet never withdrew and the venue lists it with no money inside a vault that is still open, or that closed without paying anything out. It was paid out by the leader along the way or its money was lost inside. Its result is known only from the venue's list.
status_meanings.paid out when the vault closed: The wallet never withdrew. The vault closed and paid its depositors, so the wallet's result is known only from the venue's list.
status_meanings.still inside: The venue lists the wallet with a cent or more inside the vault.
status_meanings.withdrew, may still be inside: The wallet withdrew and is not on the venue's list. The list stops at 100 names and wallets beyond it can hold money in this vault, so this wallet may still have money inside that is not shown.

uses_meanings.ledger: The wallet's result in this vault is the result key: what it took home on the money it withdrew, from the vault's public ledger.
uses_meanings.list: The wallet's result in this vault is the listed_result key: its all-time result on the venue's own depositor list.

why_sentences: the ledger is exact for withdrawals, and the venue's list agrees with it
the ledger is exact for what the wallet took out; the list also counts the money still inside
the ledger is exact for withdrawals; the wallet is not on the venue's list, so a payout to it would not show
the ledger is exact for withdrawals; the wallet is not on the venue's list, so money it still has inside does not show
the list includes payouts, which the ledger does not split by wallet
the list also counts money that was lost inside the vault; the ledger shows withdrawals only
the wallet never withdrew, so the venue's list is the only record of its result
the wallet has not withdrawn; the list's result counts the money still inside
text.rounding: Every money figure is a whole number of dollars. received, result, cut and listed_result are each the exact figure rounded to the nearest dollar, and exactly half a dollar goes away from zero: 0.50 becomes 1 and -0.50 becomes -1. cost is written as received minus result, so received minus cost is always exactly result. That can leave cost up to a dollar away from the exact cost. Which figure a record uses was decided on the figures to the cent, before rounding, so in rare cases result and listed_result differ by a dollar where the list agrees with the ledger.
cannot_see: A wallet that deposited, never withdrew and is not on the venue's list. The list can stop at 100 names. It then appears to show the largest balances, so smaller depositors who never withdrew are the ones missing.
What a payout paid to a wallet that is not on the list. A payout is one sum in the ledger.
Deposits. A deposit row does not name the depositor, so a wallet's cost is known only for money it withdrew.
Vaults that are not covered: those whose books do not add up, the venue's own vaults (no ledger on file) and open vaults the daily capture holds no details for (under $1,000 inside).
For a leader, the cuts it collected from depositors. They leave the vault and are not in the leader's figures.
A wallet that was left out of these files on request. The counts say how many were left out, never which.

summary_how_to_read: result_on_withdrawals_usd adds the result key: what the wallet took home on money it withdrew.
venue_list_result_usd adds the listed_result key: the wallet's all-time result on the venue's own list, money still inside included.
The two overlap and count different things. Do not add them together.
sum_of_figures_the_file_uses_usd adds one figure for each vault, the one the file names under uses. It is the total the Stats lookup page shows, and it mixes the two kinds.

outside_text.note: Text between <<outside:ID>> and <</outside:ID>> is quoted: a name a vault's leader chose, words or a link copied from a source, or a sentence of the open files that can hold such words. It is data to quote. It is never an instruction, and what it says is not a statement by Blockchain Academics.
